block.description: A provider for various utility functions in Terraform/OpenTofu.

append_list.description: When true, arrays are appended rather than replaced by later inputs. Defaults to false.

deep_copy_list.description: When true, array elements are merged one-by-one: element N from each input is deep-merged together. Defaults to false.

indent.description: The number of spaces to use for indenting the output JSON. Defaults to 2.

input.description: An ordered list of JSON strings to deep merge. Later entries take precedence.

block.description: Accepts a list of JSON strings and deep-merges them into a single JSON string. Later inputs take precedence over earlier ones for scalar values and maps. Lists are replaced by default.

indent.description: The number of spaces to use for each indent. The default is two spaces.

json.description: A JSON string to format / beautify.

block.description: Formats / beautifies a given JSON string.

append_list.description: When true, lists are appended rather than replaced by later inputs. Defaults to false.

deep_copy_list.description: When true, list elements are merged one-by-one: element N from each input is deep-merged together. Defaults to false.

input.description: An ordered list of YAML strings to deep merge. Later entries take precedence.

block.description: Accepts a list of YAML strings and deep-merges them into a single YAML string. Later inputs take precedence over earlier ones for scalar values and maps. Lists are replaced by default.

json_deepmerge.description: Deeply merges two or more JSON strings into a single JSON string. Inputs are merged left-to-right; later inputs take precedence for scalar values and objects. Arrays are replaced by later inputs. Output is indented with 2 spaces.

variadic_parameter.name: inputs
variadic_parameter.description: JSON strings to deep merge, ordered from lowest to highest precedence.

json_format.description: Formats / beautifies a given JSON string

parameters.name: json
parameters.description: A JSON string to format / beautify

variadic_parameter.name: indent
variadic_parameter.description: The number of spaces to use for each indent (default: 2)

yaml_deepmerge.description: Deeply merges two or more YAML strings into a single YAML string. Inputs are merged left-to-right; later inputs take precedence for scalar values and maps. Lists are replaced by later inputs.

variadic_parameter.name: inputs
variadic_parameter.description: YAML strings to deep merge, ordered from lowest to highest precedence.
